In [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], [[Yuuzhan Vong]] former-[[Executor (Yuuzhan Vong rank)|Executor]] [[Nom Anor]], disguised as the Prophet Yu'shaa, traveled to the living [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] along with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Tahiri Veila]] and [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], as well as the Yuuzhan Vong [[Priest caste|priest]] [[Harrar]] and the [[Shaper caste|shaper]] [[Nen Yim]]. However, Anor betrayed them and '''sabotaged''' the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] of the living [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]], causing massive amounts of energy to build up in the hyperdrive. Despite this, the energy buildup did not result in the devastating explosion Anor wanted, as Zonama Sekot funneled the energy into a blind [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump.<ref name="The Final Prophecy" />
